title:
A wrapper around a type that mixes {@link ExMachinaUserGroupShareable} to provide additional fields that will change
depending on the user accessing the records. These additional fields drive logic to show/hide certain buttons on the
related pages for the type of shareable in the UI. Even if a button is hidden for a user, back-end guarding should
be provided to prevent users from making the applicable API calls.

As a parametric type, the first parameter represents the shareable entity type and the second parameter is the
UI wrapper type, which must also mix the shareable entity type.
name: ExMachinaUserGroupShareableUi
